create_scans_dataset: create a ScansDataset to load ScanNet scans from a given path with optional extractor
test_scans_dataset_init: test the ScansDataset initialization with path, extractor, cache_path, and scan_filter parameters
build_scans_dataset_frames: build a ScansDataset that extracts frames from each ScanNet scan using the frames extractor
test_scans_dataset_getitem: test the ScansDataset __getitem__ method to retrieve and extract scan data by index
review_scans_dataset_len: review the ScansDataset __len__ method that returns the total number of scans in the dataset
